The Sun and all associated planets are accurately scaled and positioned within a dark void, exhibiting dynamic lighting and shadow effects. Glowing, visible orbital paths connect every celestial body. The entire system is stationary until the user clicks the mouse, at which point the planets begin to orbit and rotate dynamically, completing the visual animation.

statement: This sketch presents a dynamic, three-dimensional model of the solar system rendered using p5.js's WEBGL mode. It features a central glowing sun surrounded by six orbiting planets, each with unique sizes, colors, speeds, and rotation rates. The visualization includes realistic orbital paths that glow softly against the dark void of space, creating an immersive celestial experience.
